heard: NASA's first communication satellite was a giant silver balloon. It stretched a massive 100 feet across. Engineers built it from thin mylar coated with aluminum. Workers packed the massive sphere into a tiny canister for launch. Once in orbit, it inflated into a gleaming mirror in the sky. The bright orb bounced the very first satellite phone calls across Earth. Even wilder, its tracking antenna accidentally discovered the echoes of the Big Bang. It all started as a giant silver balloon.
